;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Assassination of Andrei Karlov]]
**Six people are arrested in [[Ankara]] for alleged involvement in the murder of [[Andrei Karlov]], the [[Russia]]n ambassador to [[Turkey]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-12-20/turkish-police-detain-six-after-russian-ambassador-shot-dead/8136774 (Reuters via ABC News Australia)]
*[[Aleppo offensive (November–December 2016)]]
**The [[International Committee of the Red Cross]] claims that 25,000 residents of the rebel-held territories have been evacuated from [[Aleppo]] as [[Hezbollah]] warns remaining residents in the former rebel enclave to leave "as quickly as possible". [http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2016-12-20-ML-Syria-Russia-Turkey-The-Latest/id-f6c46050b54f4636ade8432500f75565 (AP)]
*[[2016 Berlin truck attack]]
**The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] claims responsibility via [[Amaq News Agency]] for the truck attack in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], which left at least 12 people dead and 49 injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-38385961 (BBC)]
*[[Philippine Drug War]]
**A news publisher is allegedly killed in the [[Philippines|Philippine]] province of [[Catanduanes]] after publishing a story about the controversial drug purge campaign. [https://www.cpj.org/2016/12/newspaper-publisher-shot-and-killed-in-philippines.php (Committee to Protect Journalists)]
*Four police officers and one suspect have been killed following a raid on an apartment near [[Al-Karak]] in [[Jordan]]. Two more suspects have been arrested under suspicions of connections with [[2016 Al-Karak attack|Sunday's attack in the city]] by the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]]. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/renewed-violence-reported-jordan-karak-161220142108793.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[December 2016 Congolese protests]]
**Clashes between security forces and anti-government protesters demanding the resignation of [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Joseph Kabila]] reportedly leave more than 20 people dead in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-38377478 (BBC)]

;Arts and culture 
*[[Tupac Shakur]], [[Joan Baez]], and most of the members of [[Pearl Jam]] are to receive honors in the [[Rock and Roll Hall of Fame]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/20/arts/music/rock-roll-hall-fame-inductees-2017.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2016 San Pablito Market fireworks explosion]]
**An explosion at a [[fireworks]] market in the city of [[Tultepec]] near [[Mexico City]], kills at least 29 people and injures at least 70 others. [[Pyrotechnics]] is a major industry in Tultepec. [http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2016/12/20/12-killed-after-explosion-rips-through-mexico-fireworks-market/ (CBS Local)] [http://edition.cnn.com/2016/12/20/americas/mexico-fireworks-explosion/index.html (CNN)] [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/60-hurt-explosion-rips-fireworks-market-outside-mexico-city-n698476?cid=eml_nbn_20161220 (AP and NBC News)]
*[[2016–17 UK and Ireland windstorm season]]
**The [[Met Office]] issues warnings for parts of [[Scotland]], [[Northern England]] and [[Northern Ireland]] as [[2016–17 UK and Ireland windstorm season#Storm Barbara|Storm Barbara]] prepares to make landfall. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/12/20/storm-barbara-threatens-christmas-get-away-90-mph-winds/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*An [[Aerosucre]] [[Boeing 727]]-200 [[Aerosucre Flight 4544|Flight 4544]], used as a cargo plane, crashes shortly after takeoff in [[Puerto Carreno]]'s [[Germán Olano Airport]] en route to the [[Colombia]]n capital [[Bogotá]] killing five people and injuring one. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2016-12-21/cargo-plane-captured-on-camera-crashing-shortly-after-takeoff-/8139524 (ABC Australia)]

;International relations
*[[China–United States relations]]
**The [[People's Republic of China]] returns a [[United States]] unmanned underwater drone that it seized in the [[South China Sea]] last week. [http://edition.cnn.com/2016/12/20/politics/china-drone-return/index.html (CNN)]

*[[Indonesia]] arrests hundreds  of protesters in [[Indonesian Papua]]. [http://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/More-Than-500-Arrested-in-West-Papuan-Independence-Protests--20161220-0008.html (teleSur)]
